description: Salem - As of 10AM on Wednesday, November 9, State Senator Deb Patterson (D, I) has won a second term as Senator for District 10 with 54% of the vote. In her speech to her supporters, Senator Patterson thanked her endorsers, her campaign staff and volunteers and the voters of Salem, Monmouth and I
